summary: Moved synthetic-only admission into the existing validate_cases function so every declared SYNTHETIC_* dataset requires literal synthetic=true, irrespective of manifest schema version. The v6 replay now passes its manifest to that same validator, preventing mixed real or malformed cases from reaching scoring or report output. Three new regression tests cover v1/v2/v3/v6 loaders, strict labels, preserved input bytes and separate human-labelled input, while existing deterministic reports, denominators, failure fixtures and baseline/promotion gates remain in use. The gold dataset README maps the engineering acceptance criteria and preserves the distinction between synthetic checks and formal human evaluation.
